key_finding: Recombinant GR inhibited by HOG (Ki=1.75 mM) but not by 2-hydroxyglutarate or 2-oxoglutarate; HOG elevated in PH3 urine/serum/liver; 9 PH3 HOGA variants inactive
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate for existence of inhibition; authors call it 'one hypothetical component'; Ki (mM) >> measured tissue HOG (uM)

mechanistic_claim_tested: Does HOG reach GR-inhibitory levels in vivo?
key_finding: Authors' own full-text conclusion: '~1 mM required... ~10 uM physiological... one would not expect HOG to inhibit GR under normal physiological conditions'
confidence_and_limitations: Strong internal caveat embedded in the source paper itself

key_finding: Hoga1-KO mice accumulate Hyp-pathway metabolites and phenocopy biochemistry on Hyp diet but do NOT show increased oxalate excretion
confidence_and_limitations: Species/compartmentalization differences; terminal oxalate step not reproduced

mechanistic_claim_tested: Compartmentalized AGT explains lack of murine hyperoxaluria
key_finding: Hoga1-/- and Hoga1-/-/Agxt-/- (peroxisomal-only AGT) mice both lack increased urinary oxalate; mechanism still unclear
confidence_and_limitations: Rules out one explanation; does not test GR inhibition directly

mechanistic_claim_tested: Alternative aldolase cleaves accumulated HOG to glyoxylate
key_finding: PH3 urine shows raised HOG/4-OH-Glu/DHG; propose cytosolic non-HOGA1 aldolase converts exported HOG to glyoxylate; cytosolic HOG-aldolase activity detected in human hepatocyte lines
confidence_and_limitations: Competing model generates extra glyoxylate (opposite premise to seed); aldolase identity unknown

mechanistic_claim_tested: Subcellular site of residual HOG metabolism
key_finding: HOG->glyoxylate aldolase activity highest in liver MITOPLASTS (not cytosol); HOG->DHG reduction enriched in cytosol, NADPH-preferring
confidence_and_limitations: Localizes alternative aldolase to mitochondria, conflicting with 2012 cytosolic claim; enzyme identity still unknown

key_finding: Glyoxylate/oxalate metabolism not confined to liver; may explain why LDH-targeting nedosiran failed in PH2/PH3
confidence_and_limitations: Review-level synthesis; orientation, not direct GR-inhibition evidence

mechanistic_claim_tested: HOGA structure/mechanism and PH3 mutation mapping
key_finding: 1.97 A crystal structure of human HOGA; retro-aldol type I mechanism; PH3 mutations disrupt active site/tetramer
confidence_and_limitations: Explains loss of HOGA activity; upstream of the seed's inhibition step

key_finding: Loss-of-function HOGA1 variants identified as cause of PH3
confidence_and_limitations: Foundational gene-disease link; not mechanism of oxalate rise
